name: How long does kitchen cabinet painting typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen cabinet painting typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen cabinet painting depends on the size of your kitchen, the number of cabinets, and the complexity of the project. Generally, a complete cabinet painting project can take anywhere from 3 to 7 days, including preparation, priming, painting multiple coats, and drying time. We work efficiently to minimize disruption to your home in Berkeley and the East Bay area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen cabinet painting typically takes 3-7 days, depending on kitchen size and project complexity.
